insights:
DeepSeek raised the price of DeepSeek Pro Latest by 695%, from $0.345 to $2.75 per 1M tokens — the sharpest move in today's changelog and a hard reversal for anyone who priced against it. Z.ai made a smaller move in the same direction: GLM Latest climbed 93%, from $0.781 to $1.51.

The cheap end went the other way. DeepSeek V4.1 Flash fell 62% in both the max and non-reasoning variants, from $0.237 to $0.091, and the max variant entered the intelligence frontier as Ling 3.1 Flash and Ling-3.0-flash-VL both left the top 10. GLM-5.3-Flash and Z.ai's GLM Flash Latest each dropped 54% to $0.099, and DeepSeek V4 Flash Latest fell 54% to $0.153. Pareto Latest was cut 62% to $1.60, with the new Pareto 26.10 launching at that same price. Kimi Latest dropped 41% to $4.85, and Gemma 3 27B slipped 16% to $0.170. Also new: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 at $0.300.

The net read: frontier-class intelligence now sits at $0.091, while the mid-tier repriced upward.
